title: Sponsored Content: Last Week Tonight with John Oliver (HBO)
summary: A Last Week Tonight segment on sponsored content in local news. John Oliver explains why local news integrity matters and how paid content disguised as news erodes it.
why: HN links it in threads about native advertising and disguised ads as a good, funny overview of sponsored content passing as news.

quote.text: John Oliver did a great segment on this on sponsored content on local news
